alpha_selection.FULL_TOKEN_GRID: maximum equal-layout macro validation R2; exact ties use smaller alpha
alpha_selection.GLOBAL_MEAN: maximum equal-layout macro validation R2; exact ties use smaller alpha
alpha_selection.token_ranking: maximum median trajectory R2, then mean trajectory R2, then smaller alpha

best_k_joint_selection: within 1e-9 of maximum equal-layout macro R2: smaller k, then larger alpha, then lower ordered token tuples

bootstrap.trajectory_level_rule: resample three fixed-test trajectories within each of six layouts; summarize the mean across subset macro values

metric_authority.mae: per-trajectory MAE -> within-layout mean -> equal-layout mean
metric_authority.nmae_std: per-trajectory MAE / same trajectory target std(ddof=0) -> equal-layout mean
metric_authority.primary: per-trajectory R2 -> within-layout mean -> equal six-layout mean
